units.source_text: 半夜里，大竹夫人抱着婴儿从平塚赶来。

en.t: In the middle of the night, Mrs. Otake came rushing from Hiratsuka with the baby in her arms.

units.source_text: 夫人劝丈夫都劝烦了，哭了起来。

en.t: She had grown weary of trying to persuade her husband, and began to cry.

units.source_text: 夫人一边哭泣，一边还是温柔和蔼、有条不紊地跟丈夫讲理。

en.t: Even as she wept, she still reasoned with her husband gently, kindly, and methodically.

units.source_text: 但这不是聪明女人的劝告办法。

en.t: But this was not the way a clever woman would offer persuasion.

units.source_text: 我从旁观察，深深佩服夫人的真心哭诉。

en.t: Watching from the side, I deeply admired the sincerity of her tearful appeal.
